purpose: Country-specific game startup scenario. Factory counts/types and any fallback labor/utility capacity are explicitly simulation-only gameplay assumptions, not claims about real-world installed factories, current inventories, mines, production or geological reserves.

invariants.factories: Permanent, unique built asset IDs; no expiry with supply contracts. Existing assets preserved and IDs deduplicated.
invariants.stocks: Finite and consumed by production. Initialized once; no Day-100 refill; never inferred from geological endowment.
invariants.mines: A source site record is not a built mine. Only eligible unique sites with a canonical resource, positive reserve and positive daily capacity can seed built mine assets.
invariants.evidence: All seeded assets/stocks/fallback capacities are simulation-only and do not rewrite source facts or reserve evidence.
invariants.catalog: Only existing 21 factory profiles, 22 recipes and 41 resource IDs are used.

factoryCountRule.missingData: One scenario factory; missing country statistics remain null.
factoryCountRule.scenarioTier: small/emerging/industrial/advanced factory mix is a gameplay balance assumption.
